intent_en: Analyze U.S. household income by percentile group in 2019 and determine how the lowest- and highest-income groups compare.
narration_support: In 2019, the incomes of families who ranked the 10th highest on this list was 13 times as much as the income of families who ranked the 10th lowest.
chart_support: Bar chart titled 'There is a large gap in income across U.S. households' showing household income at selected percentiles in 2019, with income rising sharply from the 10th to the 90th percentile.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly quantifies the gap (13 times) between top and bottom ranks, while the chart visualizes this 'large gap' with a bar graph showing income at percentiles from 10th to 90th in 2019.
narrative_goal: To demonstrate the substantial income disparity between high-earning and low-earning U.S. households in 2019.
current_model_input: Analyze U.S. household income by percentile group in 2019 and determine how the lowest- and highest-income groups compare.
